_context.lastUsed: Small badge beside the sign-in method this browser used last time.
_context.terms: Footer of the sign-in screens. <terms> and <privacy> are links to the legal pages.
_context.methods.or: Divider between the phone form and the other sign-in buttons.
_context.phone.sendByWait: Same button while the server holds the next code back. {wait} is a short duration ("45s", "2 min").
_context.phone.wait.seconds: Short duration in seconds, inside a button ("45s").
_context.phone.wait.minutes: Short duration in minutes, inside a button ("2 min").
_context.phone.code.sent: {phone} is the phone number, wrapped in <number> to bold it. {channel} is SMS or WhatsApp.
_context.phone.code.nudge: Button offered when the code seems late. {channel} is the other channel.
_context.email.code.sent: {email} is the address, wrapped in <address> to bold it.
_context.email.code.sentSignIn: {email} is the address, wrapped in <address> to bold it. The email also holds a sign-in button.
_context.email.code.resendWait: Button while the next code is held back. {seconds} counts down.
_context.phoneStep.notYou: Under the phone form. <signOut> is a link that signs out.
_context.creatorOnboarding.welcome.claim: Button: start creating the creator's sandbox workspace.
